description: bob-specific exceptions to the shared tpsdev-ai preset. bob's bunfig.toml refuses versions younger than 7 days at install time (except @types/node and typescript, bunfig's install gate only — the preset's 7-day cooldown holds those two as well), so advisory fixes wait the same 7 days here; an urgent fresh fix is a deliberate PR that carries the version bump itself as well as adding the package to bunfig's minimumReleaseAgeExcludes — the exclude alone does not make Renovate propose the fix sooner, because vulnerabilityAlerts.minimumReleaseAge below still holds it. Lockfile maintenance is off. CI fails when any @earendil-works/* entry in bun.lock resolves to a version other than its exact override, or has no override; the pi rule below names the pins.

packageRules.description: bob pins the pi runtime at exactly 0.84.3 on purpose: bob builds on its ModelRuntime seam, and a pi upgrade is a deliberate, spec'd PR with its own review, never a Renovate bump. The rule matches @earendil-works/**, so Renovate proposes no update for those packages. package.json overrides pin pi-agent-core, pi-ai, pi-client, pi-coding-agent, pi-protocol, pi-telemetry and pi-tui to exact versions, and test/pi-family-pin.test.ts enforces them: CI fails when any @earendil-works/* entry in bun.lock resolves to a version other than its exact override, or has no override. A coordinated override + lock upgrade passes.

CodeQL rejects mixed versions across its sub-actions, so init, autobuild and analyze update as ONE PR for every update type, majors included (the shared preset groups them only for non-major updates).
